# snipeit_status_label (Resource)

Manages a status label in Snipe-IT. Status labels describe the lifecycle state of assets (deployable, pending, undeployable, archived).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the status label. Must be unique.
- `type` (String) Meta type of the label. One of `deployable`, `pending`, `undeployable` or `archived`.

### Optional

- `color` (String) Hex color for charts, e.g. `#00ff00`.
- `default_label` (Boolean) Pin this label to the top of the status dropdown.
- `notes` (String) Free-form notes.
- `show_in_nav` (Boolean) Show assets with this label in the side navigation.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric id of the status label.
